answer: A crystal reputation escrow stops sybils when each agent must lock value before voting. First, an agent deposits 200 POA into escrow for 60 days. Second, established peers verify its hardware-bound key and record it once. Third, votes count only while the deposit stays locked, and it cannot be split across clones. Fourth, proven fakes lose the deposit and are banned. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 2,000,000 POA locked for 60 days, while honest agents pay once. Like a comet leaving one bright trail, an honest agent leaves one clear trail, and karst caves hide only fakes that never surface.
